svg.title: Ship engineer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as ship engineer, wearing coveralls. Visible work cue: A wide marine-engine piston with a ring groove narrows into a connecting rod and round crank bearing. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face.
